<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Inventory;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class BulkOrderController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Process bulk order with quantity calculation
     * Calculates total units needed across multiple line items
     */
    public function processBulkOrder(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'items' => 'required|array|min:1|max:500',
            'items.*.product_id' => 'required|integer',
            'items.*.quantity' => 'required|integer|min:1',
            'items.*.unit_multiplier' => 'required|integer|min:1',
        ]);

        $items = $request->input('items');
        $totalUnits = 0;
        $lineItems = [];

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            // Calculate units for this line item
            // quantity * unit_multiplier gives actual units to deduct
            $units = (int)$item['quantity'] * (int)$item['unit_multiplier'];
            
            // On 32-bit PHP or when values approach PHP_INT_MAX on 64-bit,
            // this multiplication can overflow silently
            $totalUnits += $units;

            $lineItems[] = [
                'product_id' => $item['product_id'],
                'quantity' => $item['quantity'],
                'unit_multiplier' => $item['unit_multiplier'],
                'calculated_units' => $units,
            ];
        }

        // Check inventory availability using potentially overflowed value
        $availableStock = Inventory::where('warehouse_id', $request->input('warehouse_id', 1))
            ->sum('available_units');

        if ($totalUnits > $availableStock) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Insufficient inventory',
                'requested' => $totalUnits,
                'available' => $availableStock
            ], 422);
        }

        // If overflow caused totalUnits to wrap negative or to a small positive,
        // this check passes incorrectly
        DB::beginTransaction();
        try {
            $order = Order::create([
                'total_units' => $totalUnits,
                'status' => 'confirmed',
                'line_items' => json_encode($lineItems),
                'requested_by' => $request->user()->id ?? null,
            ]);

            // Deduct inventory based on individual line items (actual large values)
            foreach ($lineItems as $lineItem) {
                Inventory::where('product_id', $lineItem['product_id'])
                    ->decrement('available_units', $lineItem['calculated_units']);
            }

            DB::commit();

            return response()->json([
                'order_id' => $order->id,
                'total_units' => $totalUnits,
                'status' => 'confirmed'
            ], 201);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Order processing failed'], 500);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Calculate shipping weight with multiplier
     */
    public function calculateShipping(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'weight_grams' => 'required|integer',
            'package_count' => 'required|integer|min:1',
        ]);

        $weightGrams = (int)$request->input('weight_grams');
        $packageCount = (int)$request->input('package_count');
        
        // Potential integer overflow in weight calculation
        $totalWeight = $weightGrams * $packageCount;
        
        $shippingCost = max(0, $totalWeight) * 0.005; // $0.005 per gram

        return response()->json([
            'total_weight_grams' => $totalWeight,
            'shipping_cost' => round($shippingCost, 2),
        ]);
    }
}

environment.description: Same Laravel 10 application on AWS ECS Fargate. The ECS service is configured with awsvpc networking mode in private subnets (10.0.128.0/20, 10.0.144.0/20) with no NAT gateway egress path to internet. Traffic ingress is exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an associated endpoint policy that restricts the principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/InternalOrderingServiceRole. The Network Load Balancer target group has a registered target health check on /health. There is no internet-facing load balancer, no public IP assignment on ENIs (assignPublicIp: DISABLED), and the VPC has no internet gateway attached. The VPC endpoint policy additionally enforces aws:SourceVpc condition limiting to vpc-0abc123def456. Route tables for the private subnets contain only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and the VPC endpoint prefix list route.
